parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1134614. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1134614'. Return rows sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
